profile.legalName: Steps By Kei-che: Songs To Enhance People Signing LLC
profile.summary: A California company that offers American Sign Language (ASL) education and community services. Its work includes ASL workshops and mentoring, performances and speaking engagements, and summer camps for Deaf and hearing children. It focuses on bridging gaps between Deaf and hearing communities and on Black representation in ASL.
